integrity: The frontier and finite-horizon asymptotics follow from the exact published AdaNorm recurrence. Finite numerical replays are supporting checks only. The primary and two highly relevant AdaGrad-Norm papers were inspected directly, and residual literature risk is disclosed.
scientific_limitations: Exact-gradient, one-dimensional strongly convex quadratic; no stochastic noise, momentum, block coupling, or nonlinear objective. The result is a transient-stability theorem and does not claim divergence or give a fixed-start bound on the number of ascent steps.
title: Sharp monotonicity frontier and arbitrarily long ascent transients for AdaNorm on a scalar quadratic
